title: Wizard of Oz Escape Room in Myrtle Beach
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Wonderful Wizard of Oz Escape Room
Discover the Wonderful World of the Wizard of Oz as you travel through this magical escape room. 

This multi-room experience includes an encounter with tornado, Wicket Witch, The Wizard, Tin Man and lots of special FX digital animation and so much more.

 Our Wonderful World of Oz is one of the most amazing escape room in the entire World.
